office: HUNT Commercial Real Estate Corp. of Buffalo New York
remarks:
Unrivaled Versatility Meets Resort-Style Living. Whether you are looking to seamlessly blend your professional and personal life under one roof or you simply demand the timeless elegance of an expansive, all-brick ranch with a backyard built for entertaining, this unique property delivers on every level. 

Nestled on an expansive, deeply private .80 acre lot in the heart of Orchard Park, this commanding all-brick estate redefines live/work flexibility. Expansive single-story brick layout, and unique strategic positioning, the property stands ready to serve as a local business location, a luxurious private retreat, or the ultimate hybrid of both. Alternatively the commercial space could serve as a potential 2 family rental or in law suite.  
The Ultimate Live/Work Setup -Say goodbye to the commute. The substantial size and footprint offer the perfect configuration for an upscale home office, private practice, creative studio, or client-facing business—complete with excellent visibility and ample turnaround parking, 8 spaces, while maintaining entirely distinct areas for daily living.
Expansive All-Brick Ranch Elegance: the single-floor layout offers grand proportions, with a large eat in kitchen w dry bar and heated ceramic floor! Living room with expansive sky lit cathedral ceilings, 4 bedrooms including the primary with expansive ensuite and a finished basement with full bar.
Your Private Backyard Resort: Step outside into a secluded paradise designed for epic outdoor entertaining/recreation.
Sparkling Inground Pool: perfect for hot summer days, pool parties, or quiet morning laps. Extensive patio space with an enormous 6 car "entertainment garage" allows for seamless indoor-outdoor hosting, from large-scale catered events to barbecues. Also includes a stone built in outdoor grill/kitchen!
Recreational Freedom & Privacy: Surrounded by lush greenery, the massive yard offers ultimate privacy.
Perfectly situated to enjoy the best of WNY living. Minutes from the vibrant OP Village, top-rated schools, premier dining, and quick highway access for clients or commuting.  Adaptable live/work potential AND elite backyard amenities makes this a rare find!
